en: Dependent on an immaterial wholesome state, a non-material and non-wholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.
Dependent on an immaterial unwholesome state, a non-material and non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.
Conditioned by a material indeterminate state, a non-material and non-indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.
